name: SAMAIDEN
recent: Samaiden 与 Parkland 签署谅解备忘录，计划在马来西亚半岛共同开发最高 1,000MWac 可再生能源项目，潜在投资额达 RM40 亿。公司将于 2026 年 11 月 26 日召开第七届常年股东大会。近期多名董事及高管在公开市场减持股份。
notable: 与 Parkland 签署谅解备忘录，探讨在马来西亚半岛开发最高 1,000MWac 可再生能源项目。
将于 2026 年 11 月 26 日召开第七届常年股东大会。
risks: 独立非执行主席 Dato' Dr Nadzri Bin Yahaya 于 2026 年 9 月多次在公开市场减持股份。
首席策略官 Dr Tee Wu Shun 于 2026 年 9 月多次在公开市场减持股份。
董事 Datuk Ir Chow Pui Hee 的权益变动及交易记录。
earnings: 2026 财年第四季度（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 RM105.74 百万，环比增长 55.8%，但同比下降 21.6%；净利为 RM14.76 百万，环比增长 61.8%，同比增长 107.7%；净利率为 14.0%，高于上一季度的 13.4%。

recent_en: Samaiden signed an MOU with Parkland to jointly develop up to 1,000MWac of renewable energy projects in Peninsular Malaysia, with potential investment of up to RM4 billion. Several directors and key executives have recently disposed of shares in the open market.
notable_en: Signed an MOU with Parkland to explore up to 1,000MWac of renewable energy projects in Peninsular Malaysia.
risks_en: Independent Non-Executive Chairman Dato' Dr Nadzri Bin Yahaya disposed of shares in the open market multiple times in September 2026.
Chief Strategy Officer Dr Tee Wu Shun disposed of shares in the open market multiple times in September 2026.
Changes in Director Datuk Ir Chow Pui Hee's interest and dealings were recorded.
earnings_en: For 4QFY2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was RM105.74 million, up 55.8% QoQ but down 21.6% YoY; net income was RM14.76 million, up 61.8% QoQ and up 107.7% YoY; net margin was 14.0%, higher than 13.4% in the previous quarter.
